mapper.select:
select count(*) from qna q where q.is_deleted = 'N'
and q.member_seq = #{memberSeq}

select q.qna_seq, q.member_seq, q.title, q.content, q.is_secret, q.secret_password, q.answer_status, q.is_deleted, q.created_at, q.updated_at, m.nickname as writer_name from qna q left join member m on m.member_seq = q.member_seq where q.qna_seq = #{qnaSeq} and q.is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert:
select seq_qna.nextval from dual
insert into qna (qna_seq, member_seq, title, content, is_secret, secret_password, answer_status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) values (#{qnaSeq}, #{memberSeq}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{isSecret}, #{secretPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'WAITING', 'N', systimestamp, systimestamp)
mapper.update: update qna set title = #{title}, content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, secret_password = #{secretPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = systimestamp where qna_seq = #{qnaSeq} and is_deleted = 'N' and answer_status = 'WAITING'
update qna set is_deleted = 'Y', updated_at = systimestamp where qna_seq = #{qnaSeq}
update qna set answer_status = #{answerStatus}, updated_at = systimestamp where qna_seq = #{qnaSeq}
mapper.select: select a.qna_answer_seq, a.qna_seq, a.admin_seq, a.updated_by, a.content, a.created_at, a.updated_at, m.nickname as admin_name from qna_answer a left join member m on m.member_seq = a.admin_seq where a.qna_seq = #{qnaSeq}
mapper.insert:
select seq_qna_answer.nextval from dual
insert into qna_answer (qna_answer_seq, qna_seq, admin_seq, updated_by, content, created_at, updated_at) values (#{qnaAnswerSeq}, #{qnaSeq}, #{adminSeq}, #{adminSeq}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, systimestamp, systimestamp)
mapper.update: update qna_answer set content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = systimestamp where qna_seq = #{qnaSeq}
